rules.title: Algorithmic Price Fixing Ban Policy Order
rules.requirement: The City Council passed a policy order initiating steps to ban residential property management companies from contracting companies that use algorithmic and AI-driven models to recommend rent prices.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential property management companies.

rules.quoted_span: City council also unanimously passed a policy order initiating steps to ban residential property management companies from contracting companies that use algorithmic and AI-driven models to recommend what they should charge for rent.
